## Statements

- Stated by harness (opencode-cli, run, Flags; attach example): Use opencode run with a message for scripted work. Pass --format json for raw events, and --attach to a running opencode serve to skip MCP cold starts.
- Stated by harness (opencode-permissions, Defaults; Granular Rules): Permissions start mostly on allow, so a run can edit and execute freely. Add deny rules in the permission config to restrict it; the last matching rule wins.
- Stated by harness (opencode-permissions, Auto mode): --auto approves every request that would otherwise ask, but explicit deny rules still block. It works with opencode run.
- Stated by harness (opencode-models, Variants, Built-in variants): Set reasoning effort with --variant. The accepted names are provider-specific, for example high or max for Anthropic and none through xhigh for OpenAI.
- Stated by harness (opencode-rules, Claude Code Compatibility): OpenCode falls back to CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and ~/.claude/skills/ when AGENTS.md is absent. Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=1 to turn that off.
- Stated by harness (opencode-cli, models; Flags, --model row): Name a model as provider/model with -m; opencode models lists the valid identifiers, and --refresh updates the list from models.dev.
